why: #1096. A step that failed and a step that worked must not arrive as the same thing: the effect of a failed step is that nothing happened, which on a timeline looks exactly like a step still running. Every harness says it in its own words and the room has to hear one word.

extension.why: The pi extension's half of the same rule: the CLI's exit status is what makes a platform tool call a failure, and a failed publish is not a publish — the room heard nothing, so the silence it was supposed to break is still there.
